title: Asha declines
story: Asha sees the INR 6,000 request and thinks "I didn't ask for that." She taps Decline. No payment can be made on that request: the human has the final say on anything unusual.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order the party food from FreshMart for Saturday.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The party order at FreshMart comes to INR 6,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This one needs your approval, Asha. I've sent it to your phone.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asha declined, so I won't pay.

what_to_notice: After a decline the Consent request stays declined for good. ShopBot gets nothing it can pay with, and a new request would be a new Decision with its own Audit record.
